name: Drutopia Core
description: Base feature of the Drutopia distribution: declares the shared component dependency set and ships the site-wide default configuration (roles, media types, paragraph types, fields, image/responsive styles, view modes, crop types, taxonomy, pathauto, search server) the other Drutopia features assume.
project_description: Drutopia Core is the required base feature of the Drutopia distribution. It carries no controllers, services or routes of its own; its job is to declare the distribution's shared component dependency set (CKEditor 5, Media/Media Library, Image/Responsive Image, Taxonomy, plus contrib Crop/Automated Crop/Focal Point/Image Widget Crop and the media-crop adapters, Display Suite, Exclude Node Title, FAQ Field, Metatag, Paragraphs, Pathauto, Search API + Search API DB, Video Embed Field and Config Perms) and to ship the site-wide default configuration those components need. That configuration establishes the distribution baseline: site roles (anonymous, authenticated, contributor, editor, manager, administrator) with their permission sets applied via config actions, five media types, seven paragraph types, node/media/paragraph fields and field storages, image styles and responsive image styles, crop types, view/form modes, two taxonomy vocabularies, pathauto patterns and a Search API database server. The only executable code is drutopia_core.install, whose update hooks install newly added dependencies when upgrading an existing Drutopia site.
